service-call.name: org.moqui.maps.MapSourceServices.register#ArchiveLayer
service-call.in-map: {layerId:layerId, resourceLocation:(resourceLocation || null), alsoLayerIds:(alsoLayerIds ? (Array.isArray(alsoLayerIds) ? alsoLayerIds : String(alsoLayerIds).split(',')) : null)}

label.text: A PMTiles archive or a Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF on this server draws a map with no outside request: place a regional extract (such as a Protomaps download) or a COG in a drive, in a git repository as a Git LFS object, or on the server's disk, then register its location here. Registering checks its header and records the revision maps read; register again after replacing the file. A COG layer with no location and its provider's URL is read from the provider, its header recorded.
Maps configuration is not available to you.

default-field.title: Also drawn by
default-field.tooltip: Other PMTiles layers of the same format that draw the same archive, such as the dark style of a Protomaps extract: all are registered together

default-field.title: Location
default-field.tooltip: A file's resource location: dbresource://drive/..., git://repository/path.pmtiles or .tif (a Git LFS object), file:/path or runtime://path; empty for the layer's own (a COG layer's provider URL when it has no location)

label.text: Who reads an archive: in a drive, those the drive's members and shares let view the file; in a git repository outside any drive, those who may view the repository. A location outside every drive and repository (a file on the server's disk, a dbresource path no drive holds) has no access of its own: every user who may see the layer reads it.
No PMTiles or COG layer is registered.

link.confirmation: Register the archive of ${layerName} again? Its current revision becomes the one maps read.

label.text: No profile's basemap is an archive layer.

link.confirmation: Make ${profileName} the default map profile? Every user who chose no profile of their own sees it.

label.text: Each map asks this server for many small ranges of an archive while it is moved. Where the per-client web protection is on, its all rate limit (50 requests a second, a burst of 500) counts them, for everyone behind one address together.
